title: Welcome Flow
description: A tactile app welcome screen rises into frame with a four-step progress rail and a clear first action.

defaultProps.headline: Start with a better first step
defaultProps.subline: A warm, focused welcome sequence that makes a new product feel easy to enter.

title: Permission Steps
description: Permission cards sequence beside a device mockup, making setup requirements feel transparent rather than interruptive.

defaultProps.headline: Give your workspace the right context
defaultProps.subline: Explain each permission in sequence so people know why the product is asking.

title: Profile Setup
description: A polished profile form animates its completion state while the surrounding copy explains the personalization payoff.

defaultProps.headline: Make the workspace yours
defaultProps.subline: Collect just enough context to make every next screen feel relevant.

title: Feature Tour
description: A paced horizontal feature tour introduces one product capability at a time with progress dots and clear next actions.

defaultProps.headline: A product tour with momentum
defaultProps.subline: Give each capability its own beat, then end with an invitation to explore.

title: Checklist Complete
description: A checklist fills one item at a time beside a radial completion meter, turning onboarding into visible progress.

defaultProps.headline: Turn setup into momentum
defaultProps.subline: Show the path to first value and make every completed step feel earned.

title: Empty State To Value
description: A split transformation moves from a quiet empty state to a useful first workspace, clarifying the activation payoff.

defaultProps.headline: From blank canvas to first win
defaultProps.subline: Make the value of completing onboarding visible before the user has to imagine it.

title: Signup To Dashboard
description: Three connected states carry the viewer from account creation through verification into the product dashboard.

defaultProps.headline: The shortest path to useful
defaultProps.subline: Show account creation as a connected handoff, not a disconnected form sequence.

title: Paywall Preview
description: A premium plan card rises into view with benefit-by-benefit reveals and a low-friction upgrade invitation.

defaultProps.headline: Preview the next level
defaultProps.subline: Frame an upgrade as a clear extension of the value the user has already seen.

title: Activation Milestones
description: A milestone rail advances through meaningful activation moments, making the onboarding journey feel like a measurable story.

defaultProps.headline: Every step compounds
defaultProps.subline: Connect setup actions to the moments that prove a product is becoming useful.

title: Handoff To Home

defaultProps.headline: Ready for the real work
